name: claude-usage-statusbar
description: Unofficial: shows your Claude Code usage (5-hour session and 7-day weekly limits) in the VS Code status bar. Works on Linux, macOS, Windows, WSL and remote hosts.

claudeUsageStatusbar.pollIntervalSeconds.description: Seconds between usage checks. Checks are skipped while the VS Code window is unfocused.

claudeUsageStatusbar.refreshExpiredToken.markdownDescription: Renew an expired Claude token from this extension instead of waiting for Claude Code to do it. Uses Claude Code's OAuth client id and writes the renewed login back to `~/.claude/.credentials.json`. Refresh tokens rotate, so if the write-back fails Claude Code may need you to sign in again. Not available for a login stored in the macOS Keychain (the extension never writes to it).

claudeUsageStatusbar.clientId.markdownDescription: OAuth client id used when `#claudeUsageStatusbar.refreshExpiredToken#` is on. Leave empty to detect it from the installed Claude Code extension.
